issues.description: The template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java does not declare the expected public class Farm; instead it declares a public class AnimalFarm and contains duplicated/malformed package/class blocks. This structural mismatch prevents students from implementing or compiling the Farm class as described in the problem statement and as shown in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the contents of src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java in the template with a correct skeleton matching the specification: declare public class Farm (not AnimalFarm), include the animals List<Animal>, zero-argument constructor initializing the ArrayList, and method stubs (addAnimal, feedAllAnimals, singFarmSong, getters/setters). Remove duplicated package declarations and malformed nested code so students can implement the Farm class consistent with the problem statement and solution.

issues.suggestedFix: Rename the class in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java from 'AnimalFarm' to 'Farm' (so the class name matches the file name and the problem statement). Ensure any internal references or comments referencing 'AnimalFarm' are updated accordingly to 'Farm'.
